r1_pip.mp3.transcript: My village is covered in knitted carpets. The road, carpet. The stairs, carpet. The dog house, also carpet. Even the bell wears a sweater. But one time, I pulled the wool off the well, and something down the well just screamed. Mom said it was a fox. I didn't know foxes lived in wells. Then I found a music disc by the farm, a real song. Nobody here has heard one. So tonight, I put a jukebox on the well. Wells echo, you know. The fox screamed again. It loved the music. Then the lights went dark, just like a party. Mom froze in the door, but I've never danced before, so I stepped off the carpet onto the stone.
r1_pip.mp3.would_you_keep_listening: Yes, intriguing storytelling and mysterious atmosphere keep attention.
